title: Keep browser qualification and publication authority distinct
statement: The Release coordination Module shall keep browser qualification and publication authority distinct within its accountable browser contribution to SR-088, retaining the stated limits of collaborating owners.

what.problem: A locally successful browser step can hide missing ownership or an invalid cross-boundary conclusion.
what.desired_outcome: Keep browser qualification and publication authority distinct.

why.rationale: MOD-015 owns the behavior necessary for the selected SR-088 criteria; the SR remains the system-wide obligation.

conditions: When generating, reading, recovering or qualifying the selected browser scope.

contexts: MOD-015 and its declared browser cooperation contracts.

how.approach: Apply the constrained Functions and preserve source, output, qualification and authority distinctions at the boundary.

how_much.scope: Contribution to SR-088 criteria 6, 7. Other Module contributions and final product qualification remain distinct.

acceptance_criteria: The reusable tool artifact and RigorLoop reference-documentation snapshot have separately identifiable content and qualification. A hosted sample or successful local build does not establish customer-tool support or public availability.
Publication remains governed by the existing exact-candidate authorization and observed-outcome obligations; no public release is implied by qualification.
constraints: Draft allocation; does not establish implemented browser support or requirement satisfaction.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
